ModMetaData.name: RimworldMP
ModMetaData.author: RimworldMP contributors
ModMetaData.description: From-scratch RimWorld 1.7 multiplayer: shared colony, LAN TCP default / LiteNetLib opt-in (protocol v4), in-game host. v0.7.0 — offline feature cut: SyncMethod + colony catalog, Compat API, Session QoL, LiteNetLib, desync dumps, zero-warning builds. Requires Harmony 3. Requires a RimWorld 1.7 install for live play; Verse apply paths remain scaffolded. Untested in live RW 1.7 without RIMWORLD_DIR game refs.
